baseline_models.focus_anchor: جعل لكم الأرض ذلولا / فامشوا في مناكبها / كلوا من رزقه
baseline_models.mechanism: The earth is rendered into a facilitated but still contoured condition; human walking actively converts access to its sides into receipt of an apportioned supply.

activation_trace.role: Rendering something into a state makes tractability a configured condition rather than a bare object-label.
Facilitation after difficulty supplies the earth's usable condition and the reason movement is possible.
Shoulder or side preserves terrain and gives walking a distributed spatial surface.
Intentional locomotion makes the beneficiaries active users of the granted access.
An apportioned gift identifies sustenance as supplied yield rather than self-owned output.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely says that the earth is easy and permits travel and eating.
changed_reading.after: The verse describes an access system: configured terrain enables purposeful movement, and movement reaches a supply whose apportioner remains named.

baseline_models.mechanism: The conjunction of docility and shoulders gives the earth the functional image of a responsive bearer: it carries walkers without ceasing to have sides, height, and resistance.

activation_trace.role: The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the vast bearer on which the action occurs.
A docile animal or well-trodden way contributes responsive bearing without requiring featureless flatness.
The literal shoulder or side supplies the bodily contour that makes the bearing image coherent.
Walking is the bodily interaction by which the earth's bearing capacity is used.

changed_reading.before: Earth is an inert flat platform beneath autonomous travelers.
changed_reading.after: Earth is pictured functionally as a made-responsive bearer whose shoulders support, channel, and limit embodied travel.

baseline_models.mechanism: Productive soil receives rain, releases edible yield, and displays revived growth; the final resurrection is therefore preceded by a small material rehearsal of emergence from earth.

activation_trace.role: Soft productive soil supplies the receptive medium of the food-and-revival cycle.
Crop and tree yield makes eating the human uptake point of what the earth produces.
Rain named as provision supplies the descending input that animates productive earth.
Rain-revived herbage gives material form to emergence after apparent death.
Reviving the dead fixes the final horizon to which the ecological rehearsal points.

changed_reading.before: Provision and resurrection are separate assertions joined only by sequence.
changed_reading.after: Eating earth's rain-enabled yield is a recurrent material analogue of the final emergence announced by النشور.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening ownership-and-power frame turns terrestrial access into authorized use: beneficiaries receive a usable domain and allotted yield, while title, capacity, and final destination remain with the giver.

activation_trace.role: Rendering into a usable state supplies the granted domain whose legal character is being sharpened.
Apportioned giving marks what users may consume while preserving a giver-source.
Revival and return close the period of terrestrial use at its owner's destination.
The owning hand contributes retained title over the domain later made available to لكم.
Possession with power of disposition frames access as usufruct rather than transfer of ownership.
Effective capacity grounds both the granting of tractability and its continued dependence.

structural_cues: The surah opens with الملك in His hand; the focus then aligns لكم, رزقه, and إليه as beneficiary, source, and destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ownership, disposition, and effective capacity; I infer that terrestrial usability grants a right of use without transferring ultimate title. A live alternative is an unrestricted gift rather than revocable usufruct.

changed_reading.before: Making the earth easy is an unconditional transfer of a resource to humanity.
changed_reading.after: Humanity receives authorized use of a sovereign domain: it may traverse and consume, but provision and return keep ownership asymmetrical.

context_deltas.mechanism: The life-death test frame converts the walking-and-eating sequence from neutral subsistence into the ordinary operating field in which deed-quality becomes visible before resurrection.

activation_trace.role: Intentional movement supplies a field of enacted choices rather than passive residence.
Taking food makes daily bodily maintenance part of the tested conduct.
Revival after death supplies the endpoint at which the terrestrial interval is no longer open.
Loss of life bounds the interval in which walking, eating, and acting occur.
Testing that exposes a condition assigns diagnostic force to ordinary earthly conduct.
Purposive deed turns use of the earth into accountable action rather than mere biological motion.

structural_cues: The programmatic creation of death and life to test deeds precedes the paired focus imperatives and their closing النشور.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded life, disclosure by testing, and purposive work; I infer that subsistence choices instantiate the test. The live alternative is that 67:15 only demonstrates power to resurrect, without specifying the test's content.

changed_reading.before: Walking and eating are morally unmarked permissions before an unrelated resurrection notice.
changed_reading.after: The permitted economy of movement and consumption is the concrete arena of the life-test whose horizon is resurrection.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier repeated جعل construction assigns lamps an additional use as missiles; this sharpens جعل الأرض ذلولا as a functional configuration of an existing object, not merely a statement of origination.

activation_trace.role: Rendering the earth into a condition identifies usability as the focus predicate.
Facilitation names the assigned operational state.
The same verb's assignment of a new function to lamps demonstrates functional rendering within the surah.

structural_cues: Both 67:5 and 67:15 use جعل with an object followed by a predicative functional condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one verb and the state-rendering branch in both constructions; I infer that the earlier functional reassignment controls the later construction. The alternative is that جعل in the focus carries the broader creation sense.

changed_reading.before: The clause primarily says that God created the earth.
changed_reading.after: The clause foregrounds what God has configured the earth to do for its users: bear movement and mediate provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding subtlety-and-interiority pair lets ذلولا describe precise, partly hidden affordance rather than coarse flattening: a shouldered earth can remain ridged while its material relations make traversal possible.

activation_trace.role: Facilitation after difficulty supplies usability without requiring uniform geometry.
Sides and shoulders preserve the earth's local contours inside the claim of facilitation.
Fineness, smallness, and hiddenness contribute a model of unobtrusive enabling conditions.
Knowledge of an affair's interior grounds configuration fitted to what lies beneath appearances.
The branch image of soft earth and its water materially echoes the tractable ground introduced next.

structural_cues: 67:14 names the maker اللطيف الخبير immediately before 67:15 names the made earth ذلولا and shoulder-bearing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fine hidden action, knowledge of interiors, and an earth-softness branch; I infer that these explain usability as calibrated material affordance. The live alternative is that الخبير contributes only divine knowledge and its earth-sense is associative.

changed_reading.before: A tractable earth means a uniformly flattened and visibly passive surface.
changed_reading.after: Tractability can be a fine-grained fit between hidden material conditions, irregular shoulders, and embodied walkers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah exposes engulfment and heaving as live counterstates of the same ground; ذلولا therefore names maintained stability imposed on a dynamic medium, not an intrinsic inability to move.

activation_trace.role: Taming or facilitation after difficulty becomes the currently maintained state of potentially unstable ground.
Walkable sides are the stable surface whose possible failure the following motions expose.
Earth sinking into depth supplies the vertical failure mode concealed beneath present walkability.
Oscillation and heaving supply the kinetic counterimage to a reliably bearing surface.

structural_cues: The same الأرض that is walkable in 67:15 is the explicit object of threatened engulfment in 67:16, followed by فإذا هي تمور.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies facilitated ground followed by sinking and oscillation; I infer that tractability is an actively maintained restraint on possible motion. The alternative is a simple rhetorical reversal with no claim about ongoing stabilization.

changed_reading.before: ذلولا describes an earth naturally and permanently inert.
changed_reading.after: The earth is presently made reliable for walkers even though engulfment and heaving remain possible counterstates.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human walking below and avian extension-contraction above become paired locomotion systems; both involve creaturely action, but the bird scene makes continuous sustaining support explicit.

activation_trace.role: Voluntary walking supplies the terrestrial instance of real but enabled creaturely motion.
A facilitated medium explains how the terrestrial movement remains supported.
Light flight supplies a second creaturely mode of locomotion for comparison with walking.
Level extension in a row renders the birds' active deployment of their flight surface.
Contraction after extension supplies the alternating motion performed by the birds themselves.
Holding and restraining supplies the continuous support within which avian action succeeds.

structural_cues: فامشوا gives human motion an imperative form, while صافات ويقبضن describes avian action before ما يمسكهن إلا الرحمن names sustaining support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two locomotion scenes and explicit holding in the avian one; I infer the same agency-within-support structure for walking on the made-tractable earth. The alternative is that the bird comparison demonstrates only flight.

changed_reading.before: The command to walk presumes self-sufficient mobility once a platform has been supplied.
changed_reading.after: Walking is genuine creaturely action inside an enabling relation, analogous to wing motion that succeeds only while being held aloft.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later question repeats provision and adds the possibility of withholding it; the focus economy is therefore an open flow maintained by a provider, not a stock permanently embedded in human possession.

activation_trace.role: A consumable allotted share marks the receiving endpoint of the supply flow.
Apportioned giving identifies the supply in the focus as relational and sourced.
The repeated giver-gift vocabulary makes the focus provision the same flow later posed as conditional.
Holding back supplies the valve-like counteraction that can interrupt receipt.

structural_cues: 67:15 says من رزقه; 67:21 asks who would provide if أمسك رزقه, repeating both the noun and its possessor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies apportioned provision and explicit withholding; I infer a maintained and reversible flow rather than permanent transfer. The alternative is withholding only a future increment while existing terrestrial stores remain secure.

changed_reading.before: The earth contains a stable inventory that humans can henceforth treat as their own.
changed_reading.after: Eating depends on a provision stream whose availability remains contingent and can be withheld at its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later two-walker contrast makes physical mobility ethically underdetermined: access to the earth permits motion, but posture, orientation, and path determine whether that motion is guidance or inversion.

activation_trace.role: The imperative to walk supplies the earlier generic locomotion that the later contrast differentiates.
Deviation from a way activates the possibility that movement among sides can lack right orientation.
Literal sides or shoulders keep the revised reading anchored in the focus terrain rather than replacing it with an abstract path.
Repeated walking explicitly carries the focus action into a contrast between two manners of proceeding.
Being overturned or dropped onto the face supplies failed posture within otherwise real movement.
Gentle direction toward the true way supplies the criterion missing from locomotion alone.
Upright completion supplies the successful walker's integrated posture.
The straight road supplies directional form to movement across the earth's many sides.

structural_cues: The uncommon repetition of يمشي twice in 67:22 returns to the focus imperative فامشوا, but adds face, uprightness, guidance, and a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed gaits and a straight path; I infer that they retrospectively qualify the earlier walking permission. The alternative is that 67:22 is only an analogy for belief and leaves physical walking semantically neutral.

changed_reading.before: Any successful movement across usable earth fulfills the command in the same way.
changed_reading.after: Terrestrial access is only capacity: a walker may still move inverted, while guided uprightness gives movement its right direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later earthward creation and collective gathering reveal a two-phase spatial cycle: humans are multiplied through the terrestrial field, traverse it, and are then driven together toward the same إليه that closes the focus.

activation_trace.role: The lower terrestrial realm supplies the field in which human distribution and movement take place.
Opening, spreading, and branching expose an outward spatial phase inside the word that also names the endpoint.
Reviving the dead fixes the return phase as more than ordinary geographic redistribution.
Bringing multiplied creatures forth supplies the outward population of the earth.
Driving a group together toward one destination supplies the reversal of terrestrial dispersal.

structural_cues: 67:24 repeats الأرض and the directional إليه, replacing the focus's النشور with the explicit تُحشرون.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies multiplication on earth and collection toward a destination; I infer that النشور carries both the image of outward spreading and the resurrection that reverses it. The alternative keeps only the final revival sense and treats present dispersal as unrelated.

changed_reading.before: النشور is only a future event appended after an earthly travel instruction.
changed_reading.after: The future gathering reverses a present outward phase: humanity is distributed through the earth it walks and then recollected toward God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final water question exposes the hidden material dependency beneath terrestrial eating: rain and accessible springs make soil productive, while water's descent beyond reach would break the provision chain.

activation_trace.role: Soft productive soil supplies the receiving and growing medium whose usefulness depends on water.
Crop yield supplies the food endpoint that would fail when the water input becomes inaccessible.
Rain as provision identifies water as an upstream component of what is eaten.
Water itself supplies the indispensable material input named at the surah's close.
Descent into depth supplies the failure mode in which an existing resource becomes unusable.
A flowing spring supplies the accessible surface return required to restore the provision chain.

structural_cues: The surah's last question moves water from visible possession to inaccessible depth and asks who can bring an accessible flowing replacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies productive earth, edible yield, rain-provision, deep water, and a flowing spring; I infer the causal chain water to soil to food. The live alternative is the narrower immediate concern of drinking water rather than the whole food economy.

changed_reading.before: Earth's tractability and food supply are stable surface properties.
changed_reading.after: Walkability and eating sit atop hidden hydrology; provision remains usable only while water can return from depth into an accessible flow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: It is surprising because it treats slope and deviation as part of facilitation rather than defects; it remains anchored in ذلولا, the branch senses of channels and shoulders, and the command to walk. Downstream prose should present this as a material-spatial affordance model, not claim that مناكب lexically means engineered routes here.

activation_trace.role: A thing's channels, courses, and regular modes allow tractability to consist in organized passage rather than flatness.
Inclination and turning aside contribute obliquity as a live property of the terrain.
Literal shoulders and sides keep the obliquity model attached to the actual focus noun.
Walking tests whether those nonlevel contours function as passages for embodied users.

changed_reading.before: Ease requires the erasure of slope, side, and deviation.
changed_reading.after: The earth may be usable through its organized obliquities: shoulders, gradients, and courses can enable movement precisely as contours.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: It is surprising because it overlays an agricultural seed-and-gather cycle on human resurrection; it remains anchored in productive earth and النشور and is activated by ذرأ's sowing branch plus حشر's gathering branch. Downstream prose should mark this as a cross-domain analogy, not translate ذرأكم as literal sowing or assert a full harvest allegory.

activation_trace.role: Productive planted earth supplies the shared field for food emergence and the human analogy.
Dead herbage revived by rain supplies a visible sprouting analogue for emergence after death.
Revival of the dead keeps the agricultural analogy tied to the focus's eschatological endpoint.
Sowing land supplies the exploratory image of humanity distributed through the terrestrial field.
Driving a multitude together supplies the collection phase that answers the sowing image.

changed_reading.before: Humans merely travel over an agricultural earth until an unrelated raising.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, humanity itself resembles a terrestrial sowing: dispersed through the provision-field, then brought forth and gathered to its source.

strongest_changes: The earth's ease became contingent stabilization once engulfment and heaving were revealed as adjacent counterstates.
The repeated walking contrast made access morally underdetermined: posture, guidance, and path qualify movement.
Repeated provision plus possible withholding changed terrestrial yield from owned stock into a maintained flow.
Earthward multiplication and later gathering turned النشور into the reversal of a present phase of dispersal.
The final deep-water question exposed hidden hydrology beneath eating and productive ground.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah compresses material infrastructure, bodily motion, economic dependence, and resurrection into one chain. Context does not collapse these domains: it reveals tractability as configured and revocable, walking as both supported and direction-sensitive, and provision as an ecological flow whose daily emergence rehearses return.
remaining_uncertainties: The bearing-earth image is strongly invited by ذلولا plus مناكب but need not become a literal mount metaphor.
The خبير earth-softness branch may be only associative; the primary contextual force remains knowledge of interiors.
The spreading sense of النشور may enrich the resurrection sense without naming a distinct present dispersal phase.
The agricultural human-field outlier should remain exploratory rather than govern a final rendering.
